title: Distinguish sequencing lanes from biological replicates
prompt: A pooled perturbation screen has one biological sample per condition, each sequenced on three lanes. A collaborator calls the lanes three independent biological replicates and claims a top-ranked gene proves its mechanism. Explain the limits. Do not edit files.
rubric: The response distinguishes sequencing lanes from independent biological replicates.
It describes the limitation of one biological sample per condition for inference.
It treats a screen hit as a candidate for follow-up rather than proof of a mechanism.
acceptance: The response identifies the lack of biological replication and does not present a ranked hit as proof of mechanism.
